string.text: Threaded barrel
Extended barrel, threaded for mounting a .45ACP suppressor.
Barrel adjustment
Reduces bullet dispersion, which improves accuracy.
Faster twist rate
Barrel with a faster twist rate increases muzzle velocity.
Protective coating
Application of a protective coating to the internal parts significantly reduces wear.
Polymer buffer
Addition of a polymer buffer to the return mechanism reduces felt recoil.
Anatomical grips
Grip panels specially picked to better fit the preferences of a particular shooter. Improves handling.
Improved locking mechanism
Improves obturation and muzzle velocity thanks to tighter lock-up.
Match trigger
Reduces felt recoil, which positively affects accuracy.
Tactical combo device
Combines the functions of a narrow beam tactical flashlight and a laser sight. Particularly useful in night conditions.
Chamber adjustment
Increases chamber pressure, muzzle velocity, and accuracy by removing play in the chamber.
Lightweight frame
maintenance frame reduces the firearm's weight, without any loss in durability or other characteristics.
More durable parts
Parts have increased wear-resistance, which makes the gun more durable.
Improved ejector
Reduces the probability of malfunctions related to ejecting an empty case from the firearm.
Tritium sights
Tritium-illuminated sights increase speed and comfort of aiming in poorly-lit environments.
Trigger tuning
Reconfiguration of the trigger assembly with improvement of various parts gives a crisp break with a shorter, smoother trigger take-up, leading to faster follow-up shots.
Lightweight parts
Reduces weight by replacing weapon parts with their light-alloy counterparts without any significant loss in other performance characteristics.
10 round magazine
Decreases the number of reloads in combat.
